About me

Eduardo Pinillos · designer & developer. Eighteen years making digital things, from Lima to a small desk in Portugal.

  • 2008 · Lima · Perú. Started in Lima, building digital things when nobody in the room knew what that meant.
  • 2012 · San Francisco · USA. Won Startup World in San Francisco. Realised software could travel further than I could.
  • 2015 · Madrid — Barcelona. Crossed the ocean. Venture-backed teams, big rooms, fast nights.
  • 2022 · On my own. Got tired of committee design. Quit to make things alone, the way I wanted to.
  • Now · Portugal. Small desk by a window. Shipping apps alone, slow, on purpose.
